about_the_game:
Immerse into Log Away, a cozy sandbox-building game. Build, furnish, and decorate your dream cabin in breathtaking landscapes, from coastal shores to mountain peaks, surrounded by wildlife and beloved pets. Enjoy peaceful solitude to rekindle your inner self.

Unleash your creativity with boundless freedom. Design your cabin and its surroundings with over 500 items, from rustic furniture to charming decor, without time or resource limits. Choose your interests, like fishing or painting, to unlock:

  • items tailored to your interests, such as special bookcases, chairs, or garden decorations

  • travel bags with surprise items, which when unpacked, add personal touches to your dream cabin

Switch between free camera and first-person mode to wander your cabin and its beautiful surroundings. Interact with objects and your beloved pets, marvel at the landscapes bathed in sun or soaked in gentle rain under a peeking moon. Admire animals that peacefully coexist with your retreat and nature.

Personalize every moment with the cozy tools at your disposal:

  • capture memories in photo mode with stunning screenshots

  • control weather, from sunny to stormy or cloudy with precipitations

  • change the time of the day and lock its passage to set the perfect scenery

  • play in different visual styles, like vivid warm or pixelated for a unique aesthetic

  • manage the ambiance, listen to over 20 tracks across the western, country, and blues genres composed by Chris Haugen

Log Away is more than a game—it’s a tranquil escape to rediscover yourself. Build, explore, and ultimately relax in a world that’s yours alone, where every choice reflects your heart. Start your journey today.
